summary: Rebuilt the Projects section as a Kanban board (Not started / In progress / Done columns), modeled on Devin Desktop's Agent Command Center per Irtiza's request to replicate a proven design rather than inventing one from scratch. Confirmed via research that exact pixel specs of Devin's UI aren't public (closed product); replicated the real, sourced structural behavior (status-organized columns) using our own established visual language.
